title: anotis thymifolia var. ericoides
intro: Anotis thymifolia var. ericoides, commonly known as Wild Thyme, is a perennial herb belonging to the Lamiaceae family, native to the Mediterranean region. Wild Thyme is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that may help alleviate symptoms of coughs, colds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Wild Thyme include expectorant and antiseptic properties, which may aid in relieving congestion and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Wild Thyme include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
